text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS', 'PingFang SC', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #475569

g.text: CIFAR-10 / CIFAR10CNN / IID / 20 clients, all participate / 4 malicious (2 + 2) / train seed 42, query seed 43

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS', 'PingFang SC', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #475569

g.text: All queries reset the FL model and freeze the policy for 500 rounds. No query adaptation. Raw measured curves; one seed; no smoothing.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS', 'PingFang SC', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #475569

g.text: Adapted = 20 shared support rounds, 50 critic + 25 base actor + 25 extra mean-Q actor updates. Dashed rose = Meta-SG without adaptation.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS', 'PingFang SC', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #475569

g.text: Local SGD: 5 steps, batch 128, learning rate 0.05. Rank window: FL rounds 491–500. Zoom panels repeat ACC on explicitly restricted axes.
